item.description:
Release v5.22.1

Changes since v5.22.0

  • docs: define plugin observer ownership rule
  • feat(i18n): add localization strings for PluginGit and PluginSkill
  • feat(PluginConversationManager): switch current project when selected conversation changes
  • feat(PluginGit): add git_log custom message renderer and split tools into Tools directory
  • feat(PluginMessageRenderer): reveal header timestamp on hover
  • feat(PluginSkill): support built-in skills bundled with the app
  • fix: show compaction timeline only for actual compression
  • fix(agent-loop): preserve api key error metadata
  • fix(chat): scroll message list after layout
  • fix(message-renderer): fit tool result popover height
  • fix(message-sender): close pending queue race
  • fix(PluginMessageRenderer): make compaction timeline divider thinner
  • refactor: centralize plugin external observers
  • refactor: centralize remaining plugin observers
  • refactor: enforce plugin-owned observer architecture
  • refactor: keep only OpenAI protocol variant for MiniMax provider
  • refactor: let MessageList plugin own view models
  • refactor(PluginGit): remove superseded GitV2Tools.swift after splitting into Tools directory
  • refactor(PluginProjects): observe conversation selection to switch current project
